theorems.name: Submission.dorag_sn_open_superset_measure_lt
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid N)) (A : Set (Euclid N)), μ A = 0 → (∀ x ∈ A, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ μ (ball x r) ≠ ∞) → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ O : Set (Euclid N), IsOpen O ∧ A ⊆ O ∧ μ O < ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
